mechanism_narrative: A quarterly increase in GDPC1, indicating strengthening economic demand, boosts consumer and business confidence, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 60d returns in > 50% of quarters with positive GDPC1 growth.

mechanism_narrative: When FEDFUNDS exceeds 4.5%, signaling a tightening monetary cycle, investors anticipate reduced borrowing capacity, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns remain positive in > 60% of tightening periods (FEDFUNDS > 4.5%).

mechanism_narrative: Jointly, when UNRATE falls below 4% and PAYEMS growth accelerates (> 200k new jobs), a tightening labor market with rising wages boosts consumer spending, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: 5-day forward returns are negative in > 40% of triggered instances with jointly satisfying conditions.

mechanism_narrative: A monthly increase in INDPRO, indicating improved industrial production, enhances supply chain efficiency, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.02 over any 1.5-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When RSAFS exceeds its 6-month moving average, signaling increased retail sales, consumer confidence is boosted, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: 5-day forward returns are negative in > 45% of triggered instances with RSAFS above its 6-month MA.

mechanism_narrative: Jointly, when FEDFUNDS is below 3% and CPIAUCSL growth decelerates (< 2% YoY), a dovish monetary stance with tame inflation expectations reduces discount rates, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are negative in > 55% of jointly triggered instances.

mechanism_narrative: A monthly decrease in UNRATE below 5%, indicating a strong labor market, enhances business confidence, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns remain negative in > 50% of triggered instances with UNRATE below 5%.

mechanism_narrative: When HOUST exceeds its 3-month moving average, signaling increased housing market activity, a broader economic expansion is indicated, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: 5-day forward returns are negative in > 40% of triggered instances with HOUST above its 3-month MA.
